buckets.description: One-off personal help only: forgot password, account recovery for self, "my friend banned me", asking staff to fix their account. NOT reproducible product bugs—even if phrased in first person (login failures, no audio, avatars not loading, crashes, high ping affecting everyone are product feedback).
VRChat the company, team, policy, legal or ToS complaints, community programs, release-note chatter—not a specific in-product feature.
Not about VRChat (another game, random rants).
